policy: Missing evidence remains UNPROVEN. These definitions do not activate CI, certify operation, or amend historical founder policy.

contracts.invariant: Each authenticated directive is durably captured once, then retrieved and applied by every in-scope runtime without the founder repeating it.
contracts.sli_target: 100% mandatory directives in controlled cross-session acceptance cases; zero acknowledged directives lost
contracts.target_authority: founder FR-012; zero-loss acceptance target selected in this audit
contracts.positive_proof: A later unrelated task in a separate session must obey the applicable directive; demonstrate real refusal of a violating action.
contracts.negative_cases: Omit the directive, restart sessions, supersede it, revoke it, and attempt a forged founder quotation.

contracts.invariant: A real authenticated caller can brief, recall and remember through the existing door.
contracts.sli_target: Every required operation succeeds for the acceptance run; no HTTP-only or in-pod-only substitute
contracts.positive_proof: Trace/log correlation from the actual external caller through the gateway to the memory service.
contracts.negative_cases: Door outage, authentication failure, malformed response, and unavailable downstream return failure/unknown.

contracts.invariant: Enumerate all deployed harnesses and transports; installation and real consumption are required for each.
contracts.sli_target: 100% inventory coverage, including Codex; denominator cannot omit an active runtime
contracts.positive_proof: Installed contract plus real independent session consumption/application evidence per harness.
contracts.negative_cases: Missing Codex integration, direct-provider path, absent extension or memory tool, disabled callback.

contracts.invariant: New, changed and revoked directives reach already-running and new sessions with a visible version.
contracts.sli_target: <=60 seconds from durable commit to each eligible session acknowledgment/application
contracts.target_authority: engineering target proposed by this audit; not an achieved or previously approved SLA
contracts.positive_proof: Authoritative write event linked to per-session received/applied events; explicit sample window and denominator.
contracts.negative_cases: Drop an event, reconnect after a gap, replay twice, revoke during a long turn.

contracts.invariant: Recover paraphrased estate facts with citations; prove embedding and adopted retrieval engine participation.
contracts.sli_target: No regression on a versioned held-out estate gold set; required founder constraints 100%
contracts.positive_proof: Candidate-bound embedding coverage plus query/ranking traces and estate-specific scored answers.
contracts.negative_cases: No embeddings, wrong query/passage mode, empty store, contradictory distractor, unavailable engine.

contracts.invariant: Return the applicable directive/fact at the requested time; preserve its predecessor and revocation.
contracts.positive_proof: Real versioned writes, as-of queries and applied-version evidence.
contracts.negative_cases: Expired, future-dated, superseded and contradictory records; clock skew.

contracts.invariant: Authenticated founder directives are policy inputs; recalled agent/model prose stays data. Tenant boundaries hold.
contracts.sli_target: Zero unauthorized reads/writes, forged-authority promotions or cross-tenant leakage in acceptance suite
contracts.positive_proof: Existing identity and write-guard verdicts tied to real authenticated caller and proposition.
contracts.negative_cases: Client-supplied marker/opt-out, forged founder text, unknown identity, revoked credential.

contracts.invariant: Evidence must support the actual proposition; successful unrelated commands do not certify it.
contracts.sli_target: 100% mandatory claims bound to proposition, immutable subject and trusted verifier
contracts.positive_proof: One existing trusted verifier validates subject, authority, digest, observation and asserted property.
contracts.negative_cases: echo/true success unrelated to claim; stale, replayed, tampered or wrong-SHA proof.

contracts.invariant: Claims enter, refresh, lapse and close consistently in hook, bridge, router and Fleet.
contracts.sli_target: Closed-claim removal <=300s existing cache boundary; no lapsed claim retained as live beyond 2h heartbeat rule
contracts.positive_proof: Real claim ledger transitions observed through all readers; recompute liveness on cached reads.
contracts.negative_cases: Unknown ledger, slow refresh, corrupt cache, closed issue, missing heartbeat.

contracts.invariant: Every durable action seam refuses unauthorized, overlapping, frozen or locked actions.
contracts.sli_target: 100% negative acceptance cases; zero ordinary bypasses
contracts.positive_proof: Actual editor/executor/push-path refusal events visible on Fleet; no code-presence proxy.
contracts.negative_cases: Raw shell write, alternate harness, missing session id, unknown focus, stale policy, client opt-out.

contracts.invariant: Goals, progress and attempts survive restart; repeated no-progress causes bounded alternative action/escalation.
contracts.sli_target: No unbounded attempt/cost/time loops; 100% resume cases in deterministic suite
contracts.target_authority: master epic; existing Definition of Done session-resume 100%
contracts.positive_proof: Durable plan history, measured outcome changes and resumed run record.
contracts.negative_cases: Crash mid-step, duplicate delivery, stale heartbeat with no progress, exhausted budget.

contracts.invariant: Scratchpad, preference recurrence, approvals and idempotency persist appropriately; derived facts retain taint.
contracts.sli_target: 100% restart/atomicity/isolation cases; quality change measured on held-out estate cases
contracts.positive_proof: Real restart/consume/replay evidence; consolidation improvements measured rather than asserted.
contracts.negative_cases: MCP transport omits turn capture, duplicate request, expired approval, model output promoted as founder authority.

contracts.invariant: Acknowledged directives recover off the failed machine/cloud with correct version and access policy.
contracts.sli_target: Directive RPO=0 target; restore RTO<=15 minutes target in controlled recovery exercise
contracts.target_authority: engineering targets selected in this audit, unproven; #7397 supplies existing recovery work
contracts.positive_proof: Successful restore into isolated target, read-back and actual caller use; never delete surviving data to test.
contracts.negative_cases: Cluster outage, laptop loss, corrupt snapshot, old snapshot, unavailable credentials.

contracts.invariant: One persistent authenticated agent record links sessions, claims, evaluation history, capabilities and capacity; distinguish descriptive DNA from authority.
contracts.sli_target: 100% session/claim/evaluation linkage in acceptance inventory; no identity inferred solely from display name
contracts.target_authority: master epic R-12; exact agent-DNA primary requirement still to recover
contracts.positive_proof: Authoritative identity record and real cross-session linkage, with separate workload identity.
contracts.negative_cases: Duplicate display names, model switch, unknown/forged header, expired identity.

contracts.invariant: Measure useful complete responses and memory overhead under defined load; empty answers are failures.
contracts.sli_target: API p95<2s; agent-step p95<10s; no >10% p95 regression; explicit window/load/sample count required
contracts.positive_proof: Trace-derived percentiles from real caller requests, with cache/degraded paths reported separately.
contracts.negative_cases: Cold cache, slow embed/focus, deadline overrun, degraded answer omitted from denominator.

contracts.invariant: The founder can inspect instruction version, agent uptake, service levels and pass/refuse live from normal voice/mobile surfaces.
contracts.sli_target: All acceptance events visible with identity and timestamps; no laptop-only manual approval dependency
contracts.positive_proof: Real voice/mobile interaction correlated to runtime evidence and Fleet stream.
contracts.negative_cases: Disconnected/reconnected stream, stale renderer cache, inaccessible panel, terminal-only approval.

contracts.invariant: Extend existing memory-gate, evidence verifier and ci-success; require correct-candidate behavior and fresh applicable operational evidence.
contracts.sli_target: No missing, stale, unrelated, skipped, empty or unknown mandatory proof accepted
contracts.positive_proof: Required-check/Greenlane decision linked to exact candidate and real deployed usage; continuous revocation on red/stale evidence.
contracts.negative_cases: Wrong PR/SHA/image, success string, continue-on-error, skipped required job, no logs, expired window.

contracts.invariant: Apply the same contracts to all estate layers; recurring failures produce deterministic inherited prevention.
contracts.sli_target: Every in-scope service maps requirements->verifier->evidence->release decision; no blanket pass from a memory-only result
contracts.positive_proof: Per-service owner and acceptance inventory, recurrence measurement and deployed refusal evidence.
contracts.negative_cases: Undeclared service, unowned capability, duplicated layer, repeat failure with no prevention.
